Errorbar subsampling # The parameter errorevery of Axes.errorbar can be used to draw error bars only on a subset of data points. This is particularly useful if there are many data points with similar errors. import matplotlib.pyplot as plt import numpy as np # example data x = np . arange ( 0.1 , 4 , 0.1 ) y1 = np . exp ( - 1.0 * x ) y2 = np . exp ( - 0.5 * x ) # example variable error bar values y1err = 0.1 + 0.1 * np . sqrt ( x ) y2err = 0.1 + 0.1 * np . sqrt ( x / 2 ) fig , ( ax0 , ax1 , ax2 ) = plt . subplots ( nrows = 1 , ncols = 3 , sharex = True , figsize = ( 12 , 6 )) ax0 . set_title ( 'all errorbars' ) ax0 . errorbar ( x , y1 , yerr = y1err ) ax0 . errorbar ( x , y2 , yerr = y2err ) ax1 . set_title ( 'only every 6th errorbar' ) ax1 . errorbar ( x , y1 , yerr = y1err , errorevery = 6 ) ax1 . errorbar ( x , y2 , yerr = y2err , errorevery = 6 ) ax2 . set_title ( 'second series shifted by 3' ) ax2 . errorbar ( x , y1 , yerr = y1err , errorevery = ( 0 , 6 )) ax2 . errorbar ( x , y2 , yerr = y2err , errorevery = ( 3 , 6 )) fig . suptitle ( 'Errorbar subsampling' ) plt . show () Tags: component: error plot-type: errorbar level: beginner Total running time of the script: (0 minutes 1.097 seconds) Download Jupyter notebook: errorbar_subsample.ipynb Download Python source code: errorbar_subsample.py Download zipped: er

ESA Section 7 Consultation Updated September 21, 2026 About ESA Section 7 Section 7 of the Endangered Species Act (ESA) , called "Interagency Cooperation," is the mechanism by which Federal agencies ensure the actions they take, including those they fund or authorize, do not jeopardize the existence of any listed species. It identifies the responsibilities of the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (Service), National Marine Fisheries Service ( NMFS), and other federal agencies to use their authorities in furtherance of the purposes of the ESA. Section 7(a)(1) requires all federal agencies to carry out programs for the conservation of listed species, and section 7(a)(2) requires the agencies to ensure their activities are not likely to jeopardize the continued existence of federally listed species or destroy or adversely modify designated critical habitat. Section 7(a)(2) of the ESA applies to all actions federal agencies fund, authorize, permit, or carry out in which there is discretionary federal involvement or control. Still, retirement would be a real loss: ESG are purveyors of a universal good-time music and their unpretentious style fits this working men's club setting perfectly. The band are made up of the Scroggins sisters, now reduced in number (most notably absent is original member Deborah, who sued the rest for royalties in 2012). Their songs feature passages of stripped-back, Latin-tinged funk shunted into one another with rudimentary tom-tom fills, while vocalist Renee delivers staccato whoops and skipping-rope chants on top. France) VUE D'ENSEMBLE DE L'AFFAIRE Le 9 mai 1973, l’Australie et la Nouvelle-Zélande ont introduit, chacune de son côté, une instance contre la France au sujet des essais d’armes nucléaires dans l’atmosphère auxquels cet Etat se proposait de procéder dans la région du Pacifique Sud. La France a fait savoir qu’elle estimait que la Cour n’avait manifestement pas compétence en l’espèce et elle s’est abstenue de se faire représenter aux audiences publiques et de participer à la procédure écrite. A la demande de l’Australie et de la Nouvelle-Zélande, la Cour a indiqué, par deux ordonnances du 22 juin 1973, des mesures conservatoires tendant notamment à ce que, en attendant l’arrêt définitif, la France s’abstienne de procéder à des essais nucléaires provoquant le dépôt de retombées radioactives sur les territoires australien ou néo-zélandais. Par deux arrêts rendus le 20 décembre 1974, la Cour a dit que les demandes de l’Australie et de la Nouvelle-Zélande étaient désormais sans objet et qu’il n’y avait dès lors pas lieu à statuer. Elle s’est fondée sur ce que l’objectif de l’Australie et de la Nouvelle-Zélande était atteint du fait que la France avait annoncé, par plusieurs déclarations publiques, son intention de cesser de procéder à des essais nucléaires atmosphériques une fois terminée la campagne de 1974. Cette vue d’ensemble de l’affaire est donnée uniquement à titre d’information et n’engage en aucune façon la Cour. Introduction de l'instance Requête introductive d'instance

Share sensitive information only on official, secure websites. https://www.nist.gov/news-events/news/2014/03/essay-how-weigh-everything-atoms-apples-using-revised-si UPDATES Essay: How to Weigh Everything from Atoms to Apples Using the Revised SI March 26, 2014 Share Facebook Linkedin X.com Email New NIST watt balance, open for assembly and testing. In its final operating configuration, it will be covered and operate in vacuum. Very soon, the International System of Units (SI) may be revised to define the unit of mass in terms of a fixed value of the Planck constant, h . That move would end more than two centuries of dependence on an artifact standard kilogram that is very difficult to transfer and the mass of which drifts over time. It is not immediately obvious how mass is related to h , which is the constant used to determine the energy of a quantum mechanical entity such as a particle or wave. It is perhaps most familiar in the context of light, in the formulation E = hν, where E is energy (in joules) and ν is frequency. Mass, of course, does not appear explicitly in that equation, nor in the currently accepted value of the Planck constant: 6.62606X × 10 −34 joule second (J·s), where X is the final digit to be determined. Photograph: Kimmo Brandt/EPA Estonia This article is more than 1 month old Estonia blames Russia for arson attack on drone maker supplying Ukraine This article is more than 1 month old European and Nato leaders express support for Estonia after August attack on manufacturer in Tallinn Jon Henley Europe correspondent and agencies Tue 29 Sep 2026 10.20 EDT Last modified on Wed 30 Sep 2026 20.41 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google European and Nato leaders have expressed full support for Estonia and Ukraine after the Baltic state said an August arson attack on a drone manufacturer supplying Kyiv was an act of sabotage commissioned by Moscow’s security services. pages.text: Estonia latest country to ban Russian athletes as backlash intensifies - BBC Sport Image source, Getty Images Image caption, Estonia shares a border with Russia By Dan Roan Sports editor Published 13 November 2026 Estonia has become the latest country to say it will not allow Russian or Belarusian athletes to compete on its territory as a result of the ongoing war in Ukraine. It comes after Norway, Finland and Canada made similar announcements. The moves come amid a mounting backlash over the reinstatement of athletes from Russia and Belarus. In September, the International Ski Federation (FIS) relaxed its rules, saying competitors from the two countries would be granted access to its events "provided that they sign a declaration of neutrality". They had previously faced more stringent background checks on any voluntary link or paid duty with the military. Participation remains limited to individual events, with athletes banned from displaying national symbols such as flags, anthems or uniforms. However, it has now emerged that Estonia's government has written to the FIS, claiming that allowing entry to competitors from Russia and Belarus would undermine the country's support of Ukraine, and present an opportunity for propaganda. It said a ban issued in 2022 will be maintained. pages.text: Estudio sobre los resultados laborales y salariales de las personas con discapacidad | International Labour Organization Ir al contenido principal Documento de trabajo 124 Estudio sobre los resultados laborales y salariales de las personas con discapacidad Este estudio investiga las disparidades laborales y salariales entre las personas con y sin discapacidad. Facebook X Linkedin Detalles de la publicación Fecha 27 de agosto de 2024 Archivos para descargar PDF 2.5 MB Contenido también disponible en: English Este estudio investiga las disparidades laborales y salariales entre las personas con y sin discapacidad. Demuestra que las personas con discapacidad tienen menos probabilidades de participar en el mercado laboral y que, cuando lo hacen, se enfrentan a tasas de desempleo más elevadas, tienen más probabilidades de trabajar por cuenta propia y tienden a ganar salarios más bajos. Estas disparidades no parecen explicarse únicamente por características individuales como el nivel de estudios, la experiencia o la categoría profesional. Lo más probable es que se deban también a otros factores, como la escasez de adaptaciones en el lugar de trabajo en muchas empresas, la flexibilidad laboral potencialmente mayor que ofrece el trabajo por cuenta propia y la discriminación de las personas con discapacidad. En su última sección, el estudio destaca los marcos jurídicos establecidos a escala internacional y nacional para promover la igualdad de oportunidades y una remuneración justa para las personas con discapacidad. Its work is generally preventive and it supports the Organization for instance by providing training and capacity building to personnel, to enhance their abilities to do the right thing - also when no one is looking. While responsibility for ethical conduct lies with all members of FAO personnel, the Ethics Office supports personnel to navigate complex ethics and integrity issues, and help them interpret the rules that apply to them. pages.text: Eugène Delacroix | Louis-Auguste Schwiter | NG3286 | National Gallery, London Skip to main content Eugène Delacroix, 'Louis-Auguste Schwiter', 1826-30 Louis-Auguste Schwiter Eugène Delacroix Central Hall Framed About the work Overview In-depth Overview Delacroix painted this portrait of fellow artist, Louis-Auguste Schwiter (1805–1899), in the early years of their lifelong friendship. Not only was this Delacroix’s first full-length portrait, but it also reveals the close attention he paid to work by British artists such as Thomas Gainsborough (1727–1788) and Thomas Lawrence (1769–1830). These portraits marked a departure from a more formal, heroic style of portraiture whose primary function was often the display of wealth and social status. The use of outdoor locations, such as parks and woodlands, was an important aspect of this new portraiture and Delacroix makes effective use of the dark sky and foliage to highlight areas of bright colour and, perhaps, to hint at Schwiter’s personality. Delacroix submitted the portrait to the Salon of 1827, but it was rejected. It was later bought by Edgar Degas (1834–1917) for his own collection. His friendship with Delacroix, seven years his senior and under whom he may have trained, lasted until Delacroix’s death in 1863. pages.text: Europe plans to catch the next computer chip wave Skip to content Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live Europe plans to catch the next computer chip wave 17 hours ago Share Save Add as preferred on Google Matthew Kenyon Technology reporter, The Hague AFP via Getty Images Photonic chips use light instead of electrons to process data "Photonic chips are on the verge of a breakthrough," says Ton van Mol of the Dutch research institute TNO. If van Mol is right – and TNO, the European Union and the Dutch government are backing the idea with millions of euros - then the technology could be a gamechanger. The chips which run today's society, from your phone and TV, to the vast data centres meeting our insatiable desire for AI, are mostly electrical. They process data by shunting electrons around tiny circuits – a single microchip produced today can contain billions of transistors, and sizes are measured in nanometres (one nanometre is a billionth of a metre). Because they use light instead of electricity, photonic chips are faster, use less energy and generate less heat than traditional computer chips. Van Mol hopes for an acceleration in photonics similar to the one seen in electrical chips since the 1970s. "With optical chips, you are now where electronic chips were maybe 40 [or] 50 years ago." Coming face to fin with some of the largest mammals on the planet can be a deeply moving experience, one that’s become bucket list for many travellers. Since commercial whale-watching began around 70 years ago, it’s grown into a worldwide industry worth an estimated £1bn. pages.text: European T20 Premier League: board director Warren Deutrom says ETPL will definitely return in 2027 but earlier in the summer after poor attendances in Ireland - BBC Sport Image source, ETPL Image caption, Mitchell Santner captained Edinburgh Rockers to victory in the ETPL final By Timothy Abraham BBC Sport Journalist Published 22 September 2026 The European T20 Premier League will definitely be back in 2027 but is set to be shifted to earlier in the summer in a bid to boost attendances, says tournament board director Warren Deutrom. Matches during the group stage in Ireland were played out in a sparsely-populated Malahide, even when admission was free for certain games. Edinburgh Castle Rockers beat Belfast Wolves by seven wickets to win the inaugural edition of the ETPL on Sunday in front of a larger crowd, but a number of the temporary seats were still vacant. Crowds for the Dutch leg of the inaugural tournament in Voorburg were healthier, albeit in a much smaller venue. Deutrom said the ETPL are already taking steps to move the tournament to a time of the year to coincide with the school holidays to help get more fans through the gates. "I'm not worried about trying things in year one and if it wasn't successful, then we learn for year two," he told BBC Sport. "One of the learnings would be in terms of window, and we are actively looking at an earlier slot, probably more likely July next year. pages.text: Evaluation of CL and DM Programs in Syria | ICRC Skip to main content Report 16-03-2026 2 languages English 中文 Syria: Evaluation of Cutaneous Leishmaniasis and Diabetes Mellitus Programs Syria Evaluations at the ICRC: Evidence-based learning Health This evaluation examines a health system strengthening programme implemented in partnership with Syria’s Ministry of Health (MoH), focusing on the treatment of Cutaneous Leishmaniasis (CL) and Diabetes Mellitus (DM). It assessed programme achievements and identified opportunities for sustainable knowledge transfer and handover to national authorities. Diman Ameen/ICRC Share Share on X Share on LinkedIn Share on Facebook Findings indicate that sustainability considerations were incorporated into programme design, though their implementation varied across locations depending on service modality and operational conditions. Service delivery expanded significantly, with the number of treated CL and DM cases more than doubling since 2018. However, community feedback mechanisms remained largely informal. The programme maintained relevance through adaptive design and coordination with national health authorities and partners. At the same time, monitoring systems could be further strengthened to better capture partnership contributions and longer-term health system strengthening effects. Further details are provided in the executive summary. pages.description: The purpose of the evaluation was to assess the effectiveness, relevance, and impact of Microeconomic Initiatives (MEIs) implemented by EcoSec in Libya between 2019-2024.
pages.text: Evaluation of EcoSec’s Microeconomic Initiatives in Libya 2019-2024 | ICRC Skip to main content Report 25-08-2026 Evaluation of EcoSec’s Microeconomic Initiatives in Libya 2019-2024 Libya Evaluations at the ICRC: Evidence-based learning Economic Security The purpose of the evaluation was to assess the effectiveness, relevance, and impact of Microeconomic Initiatives (MEIs) implemented by EcoSec in Libya between 2019-2024. The primary objective of an MEI is to provide its beneficiaries with an income that supports them to meet their household’s basic needs from its own resources. Share Share on X Share on LinkedIn Share on Facebook The evaluation addressed seven key evaluation questions organized by relevance, effectiveness, and impact OECD-DAC criteria, as well as cross-cutting themes relating to program monitoring and AAP. The evaluation found out that MEIs are relevant to the specific needs of conflict-affected households in Libya. Specifically, MEIs are responsive to needs for access to sustainable livelihoods and stable income generation. Besides, despite gaps in ICRC organizational processes, the program produces benefits in the short term along sustainable and resilient livelihood pathways. Five recommendations have been submitted for this evaluation. This includes addressing the technical challenges in MEI programming within current parameters (multi-year planning, market assessments, beneficiary selection, grant amount, additional training), setting clearer expectations for MEI program results. Water scarcity, climate change, market volatility, protracted crises, limited access to finance and services, and high levels of informality all contribute to widening livelihood vulnerabilities across the region. pages.description: Governments across emerging markets and developing economies face a growing fiscal challenge. How can countries raise revenue more efficiently, fairly, and inclusively?
pages.text: Event | Raising Revenue Right: A Roadmap for Domestic Resource Mobilization Apple Calendar Google Calendar Outlook Calendar Yahoo Calendar Outlook.com Calendar Office 365 Calendar Share Event Materials Recording Presentation (PDF) Overview Speakers Policy Research Talks Governments across emerging markets and developing economies (EMDEs) face a growing fiscal challenge: how to finance essential public services at a time of rising debt burdens, higher interest costs, and uncertain external assistance. Yet the challenge is not simply about how much revenue countries collect. Tax systems in most EMDEs are also inefficient and inequitable, leading to costly economic distortions while failing to adequately support vulnerable households. Raising Revenue Right: A Roadmap for Domestic Resource Mobilization examines how countries can raise the revenue they need in ways that are more efficient, fair, and supportive of inclusive growth. The report introduces the concept of the fiscal frontier : the best possible combinations of efficiency and equity that a country can achieve for a given level of revenue and its underlying structural constraints. Its central finding is that many EMDEs operate well below this frontier—and that reforms can improve efficiency and equity at the same time. The report offers a practical roadmap for domestic resource mobilization, showing how advances in technology, transparency, and trust —the 3Ts—can help countries move toward the fiscal frontier.
